items.title: Melodía
items.shortDesc: A highly advanced, full-stack music streaming platform engineered with a seamless UI and groundbreaking AI capabilities.
items.fullDesc:
A full-stack recreation of Spotify that extends the streaming experience with disruptive features. It combines an intuitive design with AI innovation, making it possible to identify songs by humming them (Shazam-style) and to generate 'AI Covers' in real time, putting dynamic voice cloning fully within reach of the end user.

Architecturally, the acoustic recognition engine uses audio fingerprinting and spectrogram analysis to search for live matches. The AI pipeline, for its part, runs stem separation and orchestrates Deep Learning models (Voice Conversion) to synthesize new audio on the fly, leaning on hardware acceleration to process the heavy computational load with low latency.

items.title: VibeTrip
items.shortDesc: A comprehensive, full-stack travel discovery ecosystem modeled after TripAdvisor.
items.fullDesc:
A collaborative web platform that centralizes the planning and discovery of group trips. It offers a fluid, interactive experience through dynamic maps and analytics dashboards, making it easier to organize complex itineraries and manage multimedia content in a concurrent environment built as a team.

Architecturally, it combines a high-performance frontend with hybrid rendering and a robust asynchronous backend built on clean architecture principles. The system handles strict schema validation, secure authentication and file processing with storage limits. The whole ecosystem is backed by continuous integration pipelines (CI/CD) for automated testing, relational migration control and container deployment.

items.title: Cassandra Engine
items.shortDesc: A high-performance, distributed Cassandra database engine engineered entirely from scratch in Rust.
items.fullDesc:
A peer-to-peer distributed database engine built completely from scratch, faithfully replicating the internal architecture of Apache Cassandra. To validate its fault tolerance and eventual consistency in a highly concurrent environment, the system runs as the real-time database behind a graphical distributed flight simulation application.

Architecturally, it is written in Rust and implements a logical ring with Consistent Hashing and node discovery through the Gossip Protocol and Seed Nodes. It guarantees data resilience through Hinted Handoff, Read Repair and reconciliation with Merkle trees. It also includes a native CQL parser and orchestrates transactions across coordinator nodes under configurable consistency levels (ONE, QUORUM, ALL).

items.title: Fault-Tolerant Data Pipeline
items.shortDesc: A highly resilient distributed pipeline for concurrent analytical queries over continuous data streams.
items.fullDesc:
A highly resilient distributed processing pipeline designed to run concurrent analytical queries over continuous data streams. The real value of the system lies in its fault-tolerant design: it guarantees correct computations under exactly-once processing semantics, so the cluster detects abrupt failures, recovers nodes autonomously and resumes execution from the last valid state without losing or duplicating information.

Architecturally, processing scales horizontally through hash-partitioned distribution over RabbitMQ, which isolates the state of each instance. Failure orchestration is handled with application-level heartbeats, leader election among replicated monitors using the Bully algorithm, and atomic checkpoints. The whole mechanism for detecting and restarting instances runs natively through Docker-in-Docker.

items.title: SpecForge
items.shortDesc: A language-agnostic CLI platform that automates Property-Based Testing on APIs and writes the test suites on its own.
items.fullDesc:
A language-agnostic CLI platform built to automate Property-Based Testing (PBT) on APIs (thesis project). The tool surfaces edge cases, uncovers security vulnerabilities and stress-tests any endpoint by generating test suites completely on its own, with no manual writing involved.

Architecturally, it pairs large language models (LLMs) with an advanced static-analysis engine that extracts Abstract Syntax Trees (AST) to map the routing logic and the source code in depth. It uses a schema-synthesis algorithm that reads the project's structure on the fly and orchestrates the test runs, working as an intelligent validation agent.

items.title: Predictive Models & AI Analysis
items.shortDesc: A collection of machine learning and AI pipelines over complex analytical problems, from raw data to natural language.
items.fullDesc:
A comprehensive collection of machine learning and artificial intelligence pipelines aimed at solving complex analytical problems. The portfolio shows the range it takes to pull real value out of raw data, from geospatial analysis of millions of urban records and real-estate price prediction through to deep natural language processing, covering the full life cycle of the data.

On the technical side, processing includes advanced imputation and multivariate anomaly detection with Isolation Forest. The predictive engines implement ensemble algorithms (XGBoost, Random Forest, Stacking) with tuned hyperparameters. In NLP, the standout is a robust pipeline that handles lemmatisation and negation in Spanish, evaluating everything from classical models over TF-IDF to deep learning architectures with Bi-LSTM neural networks in TensorFlow/Keras.

items.title: Monopoly Game Engine
items.shortDesc: A fully functional Monopoly game engine built from scratch in Java, featuring complex state management and custom UI themes.
items.fullDesc:
An interactive desktop simulator that recreates the dynamics of a classic multiplayer board game. It stands out for its flexible structural design, where the board, the rules and the game pieces are not fixed in the code but are built and customized entirely dynamically from external configuration files.

Architecturally, it implements object-oriented development with a strict MVC (Model-View-Controller) separation, guaranteeing that the core logic operates independently of the graphical interface. It uses advanced design patterns, such as Abstract Factory, to dynamically manage the states and actions of a turn, and it is built on the Java module system (JPMS) to produce an optimized runtime that can be deployed in containers.

items.title: Zorro y Ocas (Assembly)
items.shortDesc: A logic-based terminal game programmed strictly in Assembly language to master CPU architecture and memory management.
items.fullDesc:
A classic strategy game engine built from scratch in assembly language. It demonstrates complete command of the internal architecture of computers, prioritizing extreme performance and the manual management of resources without the abstractions of modern languages.

Architecturally, it is written in x86-64 Assembly (Linux) in strict accordance with the System V AMD64 convention for the management of the stack and the registers. It stands out for its memory indirection system, which maps bytes to UTF-8 characters at runtime, and for very low-level rendering through ANSI sequences, linking natively against libc.
